text: I work as a mechanic, so I'm around a lot of dust and chemicals daily, but I quit smoking ten years ago. My father had some breathing issues, but I don't think it runs in the family.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your occupation as a mechanic, exposure to metal fumes and dust is a strong suspect. Have you noticed any specific triggers for your cough, such as working in a garage or using certain tools? Also, do you experience any joint pain or skin rashes alongside these respiratory symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: Yes, my cough definitely gets worse when I'm working in the garage or using those power tools. I haven't noticed any joint pain or skin rashes, though.

speaker: Doctor
text: That correlation strongly suggests an occupational lung issue, likely related to metal fumes or dust.
